assumptions.rationale: Educated assumption: Separation of executive and Congress means presidential rejection does not ordinarily enact a bill after parliamentary defeat. Delegated tariff/emergency powers qualify scope; complete amended2026veto procedures were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Opposition competition and party organization remain real, qualified by violence, unequal state resources and ruling-party dominance. Exact2026all-party equality is not established.

Educated assumption: Congressional fiscal scrutiny and opposition representation permit scrutiny of spending, qualified by majority control and weakened transparency safeguards. Exact current opposition-specific investigative powers were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Electoral rules and judicial supervision differ from unilateral governing-party exclusion for political positions. Religious-party restrictions and May2026foreign-interference bill qualify scope; the bill is not proved fully promulgated and exact all current exclusions were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Binding popular consultation machinery allows national policy questions with constitutional exclusions. Moderate agreement is likeliest for citizen reversal, but an unrestricted law-repeal entitlement is not established; old2015timing rules are not claimed current.

Educated assumption: Presidential initiative is strong but Congress, federal institutions and constitutional courts retain defined powers. Complete2026policy allocation was not consolidated, so disagreement with sole authority is moderate.

Educated assumption: Constitutional accusation before Senate and legal accountability provide a serious-abuse route, qualified by political thresholds and historical consolidation. Exact2026presidential criminal-removal grounds were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Defined electoral terms and institutionally approved changes oppose personal continuity postponement. Current judicial-election rescheduling is a proposal requiring Congress, not evidence of unilateral presidential power. Exact all emergency exceptions remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Defined presidential recall provides actual voter removal machinery; its scope is narrower than all elected legislators. Full current legislative/local recall inventory was not retrieved, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: Elections, recall and congressional accountability oppose unaccountable executive government, qualified by weak corruption scrutiny and judicial pressure. Exact2026enforcement across offices was not fully traced.

Educated assumption: Actual personal-cannabis authorization and constitutional autonomy coexist with other drug prohibitions and permit restrictions. Mixed response reflects selective lawful personal use rather than an unrestricted all-drug entitlement; full current substance rules were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Constitutional judicial communication-interception authorization supports serious-crime surveillance, qualified by exclusions and abusive surveillance concerns. Exact amended2026warrant procedure was not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional peaceful assembly and actual public demonstrations support some temporary road obstruction, qualified by police restrictions and violence. Emergency-access-only protection for all obstructive protests was not established.

Educated assumption: Constitutional expression and actual criticism remain, qualified by attacks on journalists and retribution concerns. Offence alone is generally insufficient; every current speech exception was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Public health and traffic safety obligations suggest some primarily self-protective adult mandates. Exact current self-benefit-only statutory powers were not traced; protection of others is not the sole rationale.

Educated assumption: Expanded security information and weak surveillance safeguards make prolonged movement record retention likely, qualified by privacy rights. Exact suspicion-free multi-year police retention limits were not independently established.
Educated assumption: National/local intoxication road-safety enforcement suggests random testing is allowed, qualified by procedural rights. Exact2026no-suspicion testing clause was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Preventive judicial restrictions and serious security-risk administration suggest court-imposed movement limits before offending are possible. Precise current prospective-harm threshold was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Broad media access and secular expression protections make purely moral government censorship unlikely, qualified by criminal/content regulation and intimidation. All current book/film/website exceptions were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Actual mobile SIM linking requires identity, but no universal government identity verification for every online communication platform was established. General internet communication is likeliest accessible without that universal condition; exact all platform rules remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Militarized public-security operations and area checks suggest credible-threat searches without individual suspicion are permitted in some settings. Constitutional safeguards qualify agreement; exact current police-area threshold was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Public-order protection and court safeguards suggest credible serious-disorder gatherings can be restricted. Exact current national/local prohibition test was not separately retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional home-search warrants and limited urgent exceptions support protected domestic entry. Abuse and changing criminal procedures qualify agreement; full amended2026exception inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Public-interest disclosure and investigative journalism coexist with confidentiality offences and severe journalist threats. Mixed response weighs disclosure rights and security restrictions, not a blanket immunity; exact2026public-interest defence was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional home firearm possession and Defence licensing support qualified civilian personal defence, with registration, weapon-category and carrying restrictions beyond violent-history checks. Exact2026home permit consolidation was not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Judicial criminal detention machinery and historically court-authorized bounded arraigo oppose indefinite executive-only detention. Actual due-process abuses qualify disagreement; precise2026time limits and terrorism exceptions were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Shared Mexican national identity and constitutionally recognized Indigenous/Afro-Mexican autonomy coexist. Mixed estimate reflects a plural national framework; an exact migrant-culture conflict priority rule was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional multilingual/community education and asylum interpretation support publicly funded accommodation, qualified by unequal access. Indigenous support is not automatically every migrant practice; precise migrant-specific spending obligations remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Shared civic participation coexists with protected distinct cultural identity and community norms. Mixed response weighs both; a permanent migrant custom-adoption obligation was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Multicultural constitutional nationality and refugee integration suggest foreign identity need not be abandoned, qualified by shared civic/legal duties. Exact current migrant-cultural retention clauses were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Spanish predominates in national administration while Indigenous languages have recognition and interpretation support. Foreign-migrant multilingual services differ from Indigenous language rights; current exact priority clauses were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual constitutional Indigenous/Afro-Mexican recognition makes ceremonial acknowledgement likely, qualified by uneven representation. A mandatory acknowledgment at every national ceremony was not found.

Educated assumption: National heritage funding and specific minority/Indigenous cultural protection coexist. Mixed response weighs real plural traditions and predominant national projects; exact2026allocation shares were not measured.

Educated assumption: Indigenous/community autonomy and national constitutional rights both bind cultural conflicts. Neither unlimited identity priority nor uniform national custom supremacy fits the documented framework; migrant-specific case inventory remains incomplete.

Educated assumption: Common civic/work calendar and national education schedule predominate, with cultural/religious/local accommodations. A single inflexible celebration rule was not established, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: Refugee employment/integration and shared civic participation favor participation beyond separate cultural communities, qualified by community identity protection. Exact current all-migrant integration programme directions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Spanish public administration coexists with language interpretation and plural language protections. Mixed response distinguishes actual Indigenous provision from foreign-migrant signage; precise migrant-neighborhood signage rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National civic identity and legally protected distinct community/family cultural continuity coexist. Mixed estimate weighs both; no current universal private-family priority instruction was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Religious freedom and headscarf-rights precedent favor lawful religious dress, qualified by identification and public-safety exceptions. Headscarf photography does not prove a special burqa exception when all other full coverings are banned; precise rule remains unverified.

Educated assumption: Shared civic integration and community cultural preservation both receive institutional support. Mixed response avoids treating Indigenous autonomy as a complete migrant programme; precise current customs-versus-maintenance weighting was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual family, retirement and refugee permanent routes lack an identified strict housing/workforce annual cap. Moderate disagreement is likeliest; full numerical permanent quota inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Permanent retirement/family and recognized-refugee pathways permit settlement improvement, qualified by eligibility and immigration enforcement. They do not give every applicant unconditional residence; exact full general route inventory remains incomplete.

Educated assumption: Family-unity pathways for permanent residents include dependent relatives; spouse status may initially be temporary before permanence. Full current graduated spouse rules were not retrieved, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: Immigration enforcement/removal coexist with asylum and humanitarian regularization. General irregular migration alone does not guarantee remaining; exact2026all removal exceptions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Employment entry authorization controls coexist with private recruitment and separate permanent family/financial routes. Mixed estimate distinguishes work permits from permanent caps; exact demand-versus-permanence policy was not found.

Educated assumption: Documented permanent retirement/family/refugee channels and protection obligations do not show a housing-reduction admission rule. Moderate disagreement is likeliest; precise2026capacity directive was not found.

Educated assumption: No common numerical permanent cap was established across family and other documented routes. Moderate disagreement is likeliest; absence of a retrieved cap is qualified rather than proof of every regulation.

Educated assumption: Actual employer-sponsored work authorization permits confirmed-job migration subject to INM approval. A job offer alone is not sufficient, qualifying agreement; complete current occupation exceptions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Student permission differs from documented permanent financial/family/refugee routes; graduation alone is unlikely to confer permanence. Exact2026graduate conversion exceptions were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual asylum access, nonreturn and humanitarian permission support protection independent of ordinary work/family admission limits. Exact numerical-cap-reached entry entitlement was not separately retrieved.

Educated assumption: Permanent eligibility uses financial/family/protection criteria rather than an identified culturally similar origin ranking. Unequal enforcement and regional mobility are counterevidence; exact all nationality preferences remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Pluricultural national recognition and refugee integration support diverse-origin inclusion, qualified by enforcement and no verified diversity-specific admission target. Exact increased-number-because-cultural-difference directive was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Current nonintervention and peaceful settlement policy oppose unprovoked foreign force for national advantage. Domestic military security roles qualify pacific posture but are distinct; exact all force-use exceptions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Defensive/security forces and modest international military posture do not prioritize costly superiority over foreign opponents. Exact2026superiority-cost allocation was not measured, qualifying disagreement.

Educated assumption: Defence/security preparation coexist with nonintervention and rejection of international force. Mixed estimate distinguishes actual self-defence from preventive foreign attack; exact imminence doctrine was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: International nonintervention and defensive national role support armed-response limits, qualified by domestic anti-crime operations and authorized noncombat participation. Exact self-or-ally-only doctrine was not found.

Educated assumption: Current negotiation and peace calls favor accepting some diplomatic concessions, qualified by strong sovereignty red lines. A precise substantial weakening tradeoff was not found, so agreement is moderate.

Educated assumption: Human-rights/peace framework and lack of documented autonomous lethal authorization make human oversight more likely than unrestricted target-and-attack automation. Exact current weapons AI rules remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Defensive territorial/security duties and nonintervention favor homeland defence over foreign campaigns, qualified by extensive domestic security activity. Exact force allocation was not measured.

Educated assumption: Maintained armed defence, compulsory service and domestic force use reject avoiding all military action at any cost. Antiwar diplomacy is counterevidence; exact hypothetical ally-attack commitment was not found.
Educated assumption: Domestic security and nonintervention emphasize national deployment rather than prolonged expeditionary combat. Exact2026external sustained-combat readiness was not established.

Educated assumption: Peaceful dispute settlement and nonintervention favor leaving territorial disagreements to negotiation rather than war. No current specific unresolved territorial-war tradeoff was documented, qualifying agreement.
Educated assumption: Actual anti-escalation/diplomatic calls favor reducing war risk, qualified by sovereign defence responsibilities. Exact all-conflict hierarchy was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Security intelligence and sovereign defensive responsibilities coexist with peaceful diplomatic policy. Mixed estimate distinguishes routine intelligence from risky offensive military espionage; classified current practice is not claimed documented.

Educated assumption: Disarmament/peace framework supports negotiated military restraint, qualified by retained domestic defence. No actual comprehensive reciprocal force reduction agreement was retrieved, so willingness remains moderate inference.

Educated assumption: Constitutional national authority and sovereignty remain while accepted treaties bind domestic institutions. Moderate national final authority is likeliest, qualified by rights/treaty integration; complete2026conflict jurisprudence was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Accepted treaty dispute and human-rights adjudication permit some binding external decisions despite disagreement. Sovereignty/nonintervention qualify general delegation; exact all institutional powers were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Domestic constitutional supremacy and accepted Inter-American rights judgments coexist. Mixed estimate weighs constitutional restrictions and treaty interpretation, not a blanket domestic veto; current complete conflict precedent was not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Long-term USMCA and multilateral commitments constrain unilateral trade policy, while sovereign nonintervention limits military/political pooling. Exact every alliance independence tradeoff was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional treaty processes permit national withdrawal decisions subject to domestic and treaty procedures. Exact all notice/termination clauses were not retrieved; national ability is not instant consequence-free exit.

Educated assumption: Accepted Inter-American state responsibility and international criminal treaty participation support qualified binding jurisdiction. State litigation differs from individual prosecution; exact2026all official immunities were not exhaustively traced.

Educated assumption: Current explicit sovereign independent foreign policy protects national interests within legal cooperation. No universal conflict hierarchy was adopted in retrieved text, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: Multilateral climate/shared-problem cooperation coexists with retained sovereign decision authority. Mixed estimate distinguishes binding negotiated obligations from external control; complete current cross-border environmental delegation was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Independent nonintervention foreign policy and economic rather than unified political blocs suggest avoiding compulsory common foreign-policy authority. Treaty cooperation qualifies agreement; complete regional foreign-policy obligations were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Actual Inter-American judgment notification and remedy administration show accepted rights adjudication, qualified by incomplete compliance and constitutional restrictions. Every ordered legal change is not claimed delivered.

Educated assumption: Multilateral institutional funding and negotiated regional cooperation support some shared funding/decisions, qualified by sovereignty. Exact2026all pooled programme allocations were not verified.

Educated assumption: National consular/INM/COMAR decisions retain entry authority, qualified by refugee protection treaties. International protection obligations do not themselves delegate each border-admission decision. Exact all operational arrangements were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Current multilateral law/peace cooperation and rights-court engagement support collective rules, qualified by independent nonintervention and selective sanctions policy. Exact neutrality-versus-immediate-interest tradeoffs were not traced.

Educated assumption: Public electricity transmission and municipal water responsibilities favor public essential network title, qualified by private operation/concessions. Exact current all network ownership was not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Current deliberate retained CFE/Pemex/public development policy favors public strategic provision even with private alternatives. Private competitive sectors qualify disagreement; exact comparable-cost ownership preference was not explicitly documented.

Educated assumption: Current public-enterprise expansion and retained commercial public institutions favor some competitive state businesses, qualified by ordinary private enterprise. Exact all newly established competitive-firm titles were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: IMSS/ISSSTE and public hospital institutions imply substantial public healthcare ownership, with private facilities alongside. Public financing alone is not title; exact2026facility ownership distribution was not measured.

Educated assumption: National rail revival and public infrastructure responsibilities favor public passenger infrastructure, qualified by private concessions/operators. New construction plans are not completed networks; exact all asset-title contracts were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Private procurement/service participation coexists with deliberate public delivery expansion. Mixed response weighs both rather than a general cheapest-provider mandate; exact all comparable-quality contracting rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Infonavit social rental plans coexist with limited verified current public rental provision and predominantly private housing. Mixed estimate reflects policy support but unconfirmed substantial stock; promised rental targets are not treated delivered.

Educated assumption: Public energy, rail and security-linked enterprises favor retaining strategic public title, while some regulated security suppliers are private. Exact current all national-security supplier rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Public Pemex and constitutionally national resources favor state extraction in strategic fields, qualified by private mining/contractors. National resource sovereignty alone is not title of every extractor; complete current firm inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Municipal routine service responsibilities and private concession/procurement coexist. Mixed response weighs actual delivery variation; no general nationwide private-provider preference was established.

Educated assumption: USMCA/treaty market access coexists with new nonpartner import protection. Mixed response weighs implemented openness and protection rather than all barriers removed regardless of domestic sales losses.

Educated assumption: Plan Mexico domestic industrial priorities suggest domestic procurement preference, qualified by treaty procurement/competitive sourcing. Exact2026price-premium rule was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Broad international sourcing coexists with country/product tariff differences and strategic restrictions. Mixed response reflects real constrained choice; precise every prohibited source inventory remains incomplete.

Educated assumption: Current domestic strategic production/food security and import duties favor some essential-goods protection, qualified by import dependence and treaty access. Exact all cheaper-essential import restrictions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Current nonpartner tariff increases make broad unilateral reduction less likely, qualified by FTAs and selected exemptions. Exact2026each reciprocal-policy condition was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual tariff protection and domestic industrial incentives suggest some temporary infant-industry support, qualified by mature-industry protection. Precise new-industry versus existing-sector measures were not fully inventoried.

Educated assumption: Foreign investment and treaty protections coexist with reserved strategic fields and nationality-specific restrictions. Mixed response weighs real access and unequal strategic eligibility; exact all current sector rules were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Food sovereignty and maize safeguards favor some farming protection, qualified by substantial imported agricultural inputs and trade commitments. Maize cultivation prohibition is not automatically a blanket food import ban; exact2026all quotas were not traced.

Educated assumption: USMCA cooperation and negotiated responses coexist with new nonpartner protection. Mexico’s own2026duties are not automatically retaliation against USexport tariffs; an all-current retaliatory tariff inventory was not found.

Educated assumption: Common domestic product taxation and trade-treaty nondiscrimination suggest comparable product taxes, qualified by customs charges and exemptions. Import tariffs are distinct; exact all2026VAT/excise differences were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Trade-remedy administration and protective industry policy suggest restrictions against unfair subsidized imports, qualified by proof/procedure. Exact current all countervailing cases were not independently retrieved.

Educated assumption: Reserved/public strategic energy sectors constrain foreign controlling ownership, qualified by permitted private investment/joint ventures. Exact all current strategic investor exceptions were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Digital cross-border commerce and foreign platforms remain accessible, qualified by tax/identity/sector regulation. Exact current special foreign-online service restrictions were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: National strategic production/energy mandates coexist with no broad compulsory output targets for private ordinary firms. Mixed response weighs sector planning and market production; exact all2026target mandates were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Ordinary market prices predominate with regulated utilities and essential-price interventions. Exact nationwide price-control inventory was not retrieved, so general market determination is moderate.

Educated assumption: Ordinary private entry/closure follows market demand while strategic state firms remain supported. Full current administrative closure/expansion rules were not consolidated, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: Public strategic energy and essential-affordability policy favor some regulated essential prices, qualified by most ordinary market pricing. Exact current all administered basic-goods schedules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Ordinary private market entry/licensing generally differs from a compulsory production-need test, qualified by strategic reservations and authorizations. Complete current licensing inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual public development banks finance nationally selected infrastructure, with private commercial credit alongside. Moderate direction is likeliest in public banking; no blanket compulsory direction of all private banks was established.

Educated assumption: International investment/convertible peso framework suggests ordinary capital transfers without general prior approval, qualified by reporting, tax and financial-crime rules. Exact all2026outflow exemptions were not traced.

Educated assumption: National peso legal-money authority and regulated finance favor restricting private currency competition, qualified by digital payment/crypto activity. Exact current privately issued currency legal-tender rules were not retrieved.
Educated assumption: Ordinary private wages are negotiated subject to national floors, while public servants have salary schedules. Exact2026sectoral wage coverage was not measured.

Educated assumption: Actual February2026SCJN validates CDMX annual rent-increase inflation cap while initial rents remain contractually negotiated, alongside national private rental markets and future social rental plans. Mixed response reflects real market entry prices plus bounded renewal controls; exact all other regional rental laws were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Ordinary private production/distribution coexist with public strategic energy mandates and coordinated industrial investment. Mixed response weighs substantial targeted planning rather than universal government ordinary output coordination.

Educated assumption: Actual cash pensions, rural transfers and progressive income tax narrow disposable-income differences, qualified by modest revenue and working-age gaps. Exact2026all-cash redistribution magnitude was not measured.

Educated assumption: Expanded cash support and progressive structure imply inequality reduction can justify some taxes, qualified by low overall collections. Exact general taxation-solely-for-equality position was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual expanded category cash benefits coexist with fiscal restraint and limited broad working-age minimum income. Mixed response weighs expansion and reluctance/limited capacity for higher taxes; no universal stronger minimum cash entitlement is claimed.

Educated assumption: Cash schemes prioritize vulnerability/basic protection and productive support rather than comprehensive living-standard equalization. Broader older-person coverage is counterevidence; exact2026adequacy decomposition was not measured.

Educated assumption: Graduated national income-tax schedule gives higher earners higher rates, qualified by deductions and modest tax reach. Full2026bracket table retrieval failed; no exact unverified thresholds or effective-rate comparison is claimed.

Educated assumption: Low revenue collection and investment incentives coexist with progressive income tax and expanded transfers. Mixed response weighs earnings retention and distribution policy, not inferred preferred inequality.

Educated assumption: Official consolidated inheritance income exemption suggests no general large-inheritance levy funding transfers. Precise2026all estate/local taxes were not consolidated, so disagreement is moderate.

Educated assumption: Youth training stipend is capped in duration while productive rural support and pensions continue under conditions. Mixed response avoids extending one youth-training cap to all work-capable adults; full current working-age cash schemes were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Current fiscal structure emphasizes income/consumption/local property taxes rather than a verified broad accumulated-wealth transfer tax. Property tax is counterevidence but not automatically a net-wealth levy; exact2026all wealth instruments were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Budget restraint and limited working-age support coexist with enlarged category cash pensions. Mixed response weighs fiscal modesty and benefit expansion; the exact lower-tax-for-smaller-benefit tradeoff was not documented.

Educated assumption: Actual older-person pension rights frame dignified/autonomous participation beyond bare survival, qualified by limited measured cash adequacy and access. Exact2026all households’ ordinary-social-life sufficiency was not established.

Educated assumption: Actual pension/rural cash expansion argues against tax cuts taking general priority over cash benefits, qualified by investment incentives and revenue restraint. Precise2026all cash-versus-tax comparison was not measured.

Educated assumption: Actual Sembrando Vida supplements participating small producers’ household income while youth stipend is training support, not ordinary employee wage top-up. Moderate qualified cash supplement support is likeliest; broad low-paid employee top-up coverage was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual progressive income-tax structure contradicts equal marginal rates for all earnings, qualified by special regimes/deductions. Full2026table timed out; exact brackets are not claimed.

Educated assumption: Constitutional agrarian redistribution/compensation framework coexists with current producer support rather than verified broad new land redistribution. Mixed response weighs retained mechanism and incomplete current implementation, not assuming historical reform is contemporary delivery.

Educated assumption: Secular public education rejects faith persuasion while religion/cultural history may be taught. Exact2026all comparative religion curricula were not retrieved, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: Secular national ceremonies generally follow civic constitutional institutions, qualified by heritage symbolism and private religious attendance. Exact2026all ceremony worship practices were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Secular public funding framework favors civic/cultural rather than faith-strengthening purposes, qualified by heritage building support. Cultural conservation is not proof of religious instruction funding; exact current all spending clauses were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Official secular administration opposes endorsement displays, qualified by historically religious art/buildings. Exact current all public building display inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Official Christmas rest and Easter school breaks coexist with secular constitutional justification and no official religion. Mixed response separates inherited calendar accommodation from recognition of a religion; exact current all state holiday rationales were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Secular fiscal framework makes special faith-strengthening exemptions beyond nonprofit/charitable treatment less likely. Religious associations may have qualified nonprofit treatment; exact current religion-only tax clauses were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual marriage/family rights and reproductive court reforms permit substantial social change, qualified by uneven implementation and retained community traditions. Exact2026all customs policy was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual equal-family and gender-rights developments favor adaptation rather than universal inherited-tradition priority. Community autonomy/heritage qualify disagreement; citizen attitudes are not claimed.

Educated assumption: Civil rights precedent protects nonmarried/diverse family forms, qualified by unequal practice and benefit categories. Exact universal social recognition is not directly measured.

Educated assumption: Constitutional gender equality and women’s economic/public participation favor moving beyond compulsory traditional roles, qualified by violence and labour disparity. Exact all social-policy role expectations were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Civil protection of diverse family forms coexists with family-oriented childcare and parental support. Mixed estimate weighs retained household continuity and equal nontraditional forms; no current universal married-two-parent preference was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual current abortion court relief and decriminalization support early reproductive choice in relevant states, qualified by regional access restrictions. Legal relief is not a measured universal citizen social acceptance or all-state identical service provision.

Educated assumption: National secular curriculum/equality protections suggest parents do not hold an unrestricted final veto over traditional sexual-value conflicts. Family rights qualify disagreement; precise2026all opt-out rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Equal marriage and diverse-family constitutional reasoning support same-sex adoptive recognition, qualified by uneven administration. Exact2026every state adoption rule and public social acceptance were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Secular expression/religious dress freedom imply no general traditional modesty duty, qualified by local cultural/social pressure. Exact current all public dress restrictions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Official gender equality/diversity recognition suggests inclusive self-identification terminology, qualified by ordinary linguistic conventions. Exact compulsory naming/pronoun rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Community heritage transmission and early learning coexist with evolving civil equality. Mixed response weighs continuity and adaptation; actual curriculum moral-innovation priority was not directly inventoried.

Educated assumption: Constitutional equality and public participation favor acceptance of adults in nontraditional roles, qualified by entrenched discrimination. Complete2026institutional role acceptance was not measured.

Educated assumption: Recent rights reforms/court relief show substantial legal change rather than a universal slow-change preference. Regional variation and inherited institutions qualify disagreement; exact all reform timing directives were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Secular rights/equality education makes diverse orientation/gender teaching likely despite family disagreement, qualified by implementation variation. Exact compulsory2026curriculum coverage/opt-outs were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual Indigenous/Afro-Mexican recognition and heritage support favor preserving intergenerational customs, qualified by civil equality limits. Specific preservation after all practical purpose disappears was not explicitly documented.

Educated assumption: Actual digital adoption/industrial innovation incentives support some early benefits-led use, qualified by sectoral health/environment safeguards. No technology-wide permission despite every long-term risk was found.

Educated assumption: Implemented digital/industrial innovation extends beyond permanently small trials, qualified by biosafety/clinical restrictions. Exact technology-wide long-term evidence threshold was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National rail/housing/energy construction priorities can outweigh some habitat preservation, qualified by environmental approval and disputes. Future project targets are not all completed habitat loss; precise current irreversible-loss authorizations were not audited.
Educated assumption: Health authorization and precautionary biosafety context favor studied medical safety before broad use. Exact2026all long-term evidence durations were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Digital productivity investment and training incentives favor AI adoption with retraining, qualified by actual artist protection and no comprehensive2026AIlaw established. Exact willingness to replace many existing jobs was not explicitly documented.

Educated assumption: Actual infrastructure development priority suggests undisturbed habitat is not always paramount, qualified by conservation/maize biodiversity protection. Precise current all project tradeoffs were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Precautionary food/biosafety protection and clinical authorization context make cultivated-meat replacement before environmental evidence less likely. No exact current product authorization or explicit replacement programme was found; maize policy is contextual, not identical technology evidence.

Educated assumption: Clinical/ethical safety oversight makes healthy brain enhancement research-first likely, qualified by innovation incentives. Exact current healthy-implant authorization law was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Digital/energy technology investment coexists with ecosystem protection, efficiency and community production programmes. Mixed response weighs technology and conservation rather than unproven technology universally taking priority; exact hierarchy was not found.

Educated assumption: Environmental safeguards coexist with accelerated rail/housing development. Mixed response weighs formal assessment and urgent construction, not automatic delay of every unknown effect; exact current all approval practices were not inventoried.
Educated assumption: Health authorization/precaution context makes basic-safety-only healthy brain enhancement permission unlikely. Exact2026long-term implant rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Clinical safety and uneven digital-health readiness favor supervised diagnostic AI reliability testing. Exact patient-group evidence threshold was not retrieved; artist copyright safeguards are not medical reliability rules.

Educated assumption: Ethical/clinical precaution context makes human-ability embryo enhancement trials less likely than disease-focused research. Exact current germline enhancement statute/exemption was not retrieved; crop GMO policy is not direct human embryo proof.

Educated assumption: Actual rail/housing programme priorities favor development in some undeveloped-land conflicts, qualified by environmental safeguards. Future network/rental targets are not all completed construction; precise all land approvals were not measured.

Educated assumption: Actual maize irreversible biodiversity protections and medical safeguards favor delaying serious irreversible-harm technologies, qualified by digital/industrial adoption. Exact broad strong-evidence harm criterion was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Federal supremacy and reserved state competence coexist with constitutional judicial dispute resolution. Mixed response distinguishes national constitutional limits from executive sole final discretion; complete amended2026competence jurisprudence was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional federal union and national territorial integrity do not establish unilateral state-majority secession. Exact2026secession jurisprudence was not retrieved, qualifying disagreement.

Educated assumption: Binding national constitutional/framework law can displace conflicting state policy, qualified by protected state competence and court review. Exact all nationwide-programme override provisions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: State/municipal police coexist with national Guard/federal security coordination. Mixed command existence argues against a single sole national police authority, qualified by military/federal expansion; exact2026all operational command arrangements were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Federal tax/transfer dependence and comparatively limited local fiscal collections make keeping most locally collected total revenue unlikely. Municipal property tax retention is counterevidence; exact2026aggregate shares were not claimed.

Educated assumption: National educational framework/curriculum authority coexist with region/community adaptation and multilingual models. Exact2026all compulsory subject allocations were not retrieved, qualifying national determination.

Educated assumption: National constitutional/federal private employment framework sets wage/hours/dismissal rights, while state public-service employment differs. Exact2026all private/public sector exceptions were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: State constitutional and legislative municipal powers coexist with local elected councils. Mixed estimate reflects subnational rather than national boundary oversight; local voters’ sole power without state approval was not established.
Educated assumption: National public healthcare institutions/coverage standards coexist with state delivery and varying access. Exact2026regional optional treatment entitlements were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Constitutional limits on state taxation coexist with local property-rate variation. Mixed response distinguishes national prohibited tax bases from a general national tax-competition rate floor; OECDrecommended minimum property rates are not implemented by assumption.

Educated assumption: Reserved state/local land administration and wildlife responsibilities allow regional choice within national ecological/resource law. Exact2026sole-local-effect wildlife powers were not retrieved, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: National civil-protection/security coordination likely directs multi-region disaster response, with state/municipal implementation. Exact2026override of conflicting local plans was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual caregiver/early education intervention treats social surroundings and upbringing as behavioral causes. Moderate environmental predominance is likeliest, qualified by developmental individuality; no national all-behavior genetic decomposition was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Educational access/skills inequality policy favors schooling/opportunity explanations over inherited national IQ hierarchy. Exact cross-country inherited contribution was not measured; national economic differences are not genetic proof.

Educated assumption: Gender equality and documented care/work barriers support social expectation explanations for behavioral role differences, qualified by biological development. Exact sex-behavior causal shares were not quantified.

Educated assumption: Supportive caregiving and developmental individuality suggest both experience and biological susceptibility shape stress. Mixed interaction is likeliest; precise comparative predominance was not measured.

Educated assumption: Early learning materials and skills access treat experiences/opportunity as shaping interests. Inherited variation qualifies the moderate environmental estimate; exact trait decomposition was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Child learning/caregiver guidance support experience and modeled safety in risk behavior, qualified by individual differences. No national inherited-risk predominance theory was found.

Educated assumption: Community early education and parent interaction shape cooperative habits. Moderate social predominance is likeliest, qualified by developmental variation; exact inherited contribution was not measured.

Educated assumption: Caregiver/community relationships and early development support learned empathy, qualified by susceptibility differences. Precise national empathy genetics predominance was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual IMSS clinical ADHD guidance recognizes neurodevelopmental, genetic, gestational and birth-injury factors alongside educational strategies; early learning recognizes environmental contribution. Mixed interaction is likeliest for ordinary attention, qualified because clinical ADHD does not establish all population attention causes or precise genetic/environmental shares.

Educated assumption: Community cultural transmission and caregiver learning give acquired norms causal weight. Immediate moral intuition differs from explicit lessons; precise biological-versus-cultural predominance remains unquantified.
